title: herdr-peers delegation record (protocol 1)
description: One line of the append-only delegation log (machine-scoped XDG state, or $HERDR_PEERS_LOG; mirrored to $DWP_PLAN/analysis_results/delegations.ndjson when DWP_PLAN is set). Each state change appends a new line; the latest line per (role, id) is the current state. Records carry server_id so a shared override can be filtered by Herdr server. The fields task, transport, via, kind, profile, target, worktree, prompt_digest, state and result_path are the plan-agnostic delegation shape; prompts are stored as digests, never as text. Notices and lead-record changes use the same shape (roles notifier, notified, lead).

id.description: The ask or notice id (ULID) — the correlation key on both sides; a fresh id for each lead-record change.

ts.description: UTC time the line was written.

role.description: caller = this pane sent the ask; delegate = this pane received it; notifier = this pane sent a notice; notified = this pane received one; lead = a change to a plan's lead record (claim, refresh, handover, takeover, release, or a lead notice adopted, rejected or causing a step-down).

self.description: This pane's address as used in the exchange.

server_id.description: Opaque Herdr server identity used to isolate shared checkout state.

task.description: Task the delegation serves (--task, else $DWP_TASK), or null.

transport.description: A peer in a pane (as opposed to a headless run).

via.description: The integration key that carried the delegation.

kind.description: The peer's agent kind as Herdr reports it (claude, codex, …).

profile.description: The agent profile or account the peer runs with (--profile, e.g. @work1), or null. Repeated on every later record of the ask.

target.description: The peer on the other end: the asked pane (caller) or the asking pane (delegate).

vendor.description: The peer agent's vendor (--vendor, else derived from kind: anthropic, openai, …); optional, absent when unknown.

worktree.description: The writing peer's worktree (--worktree), or null.

prompt_digest.description: sha256 of the full ask message.

state.description: Asks: launched, completed, failed, cancelled, unroutable. Notices: sent or failed (notifier), received (notified). Lead records: claimed … rejected.

result_path.description: Caller side, completed: the file holding the reply.

reply_digest.description: sha256 of the full reply message, when known.

source.description: How a reply was recorded: from the received message (check) or captured from the pane (wait).

reason.description: Why the fan-out cap was raised for this ask.

note.description: Free text: a cancel reason, a transport failure line, or why a lead notice was rejected.

plan.description: Lead records and lead notices: the plan whose lead record is concerned.

epoch.description: Lead records: the epoch after the change (or the rejected notice's epoch).

capacity.description: The capacity line (capacity=<verdict> [NN%] [@profile]) a received message carried; read by `lanes`.
